tower.archer.name: Archer Tower
tower.archer.desc: Fast, cheap and reliable. Hits ground and air.
tower.cannon.name: Cannon
tower.cannon.desc: Slow shells that explode and punch through armor. Cannot hit flyers.
tower.fire.name: Fire Brazier
tower.fire.desc: Sets enemies ablaze: they keep burning after the hit.
tower.ice.name: Frost Spire
tower.ice.desc: Low damage, but slows enemies so other towers get more shots.
tower.poison.name: Poison Cauldron
tower.poison.desc: Stacking poison ignores armor and corrodes it.
tower.storm.name: Storm Coil
tower.storm.desc: Lightning jumps between enemies. Great against crowds.
tower.arcane.name: Arcane Obelisk
tower.arcane.desc: A beam that grows stronger on one target and marks it for everyone.
tower.sun.name: Sun Totem
tower.sun.desc: Speeds up nearby towers and burns everything around with light.
tower.frostfire.name: Frostfire Brazier

tower.steam.name: Steam Geyser
tower.steam.desc: Hybrid. Scalding bursts hit every ground enemy nearby.
tower.venom.name: Venom Ballista
tower.venom.desc: Hybrid. Long-range bolts that poison and shred armor.
tower.meteor.name: Meteor Mortar

tower.frostcannon.name: Glacier Bombard

tower.stormglacier.name: Tempest Glacier

tower.plaguefire.name: Plague Furnace
tower.plaguefire.desc: Hybrid. Poison and fire together; victims explode.
tower.runestorm.name: Rune Storm
tower.runestorm.desc: Hybrid. Lightning that marks every enemy it strikes.
tower.solarprism.name: Solar Prism
tower.solarprism.desc: Hybrid. Twin beams of light that also speed up allies.
branch.marksman.name: Marksman
branch.marksman.desc: Long range, heavy shots and deadly critical hits.
branch.volley.name: Volley Tower
branch.volley.desc: Fires at three enemies at once.
branch.mortar.name: Mortar
branch.mortar.desc: Longer range and a much bigger blast.
branch.shrapnel.name: Shrapnel Battery

branch.inferno.name: Inferno

support.title: Support
support.hint: Report a bug, a purchase problem or lost progress.
support.privacy: Technical info contains the game version, device type and your progress summary. No contacts, files or location are collected.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.text: The game stores your progress on this device. If you use cloud saves, your progress and, when you create an account, your e-mail are stored on the game server so you can restore them. Advertising and purchases are handled by the Google and Apple platforms under their own policies. Error logs are sent only when you choose to attach them to a support request. You can delete your local profile and your cloud account at any time in Settings.
